semantics: Statement is Caesar-shifted by 10 letters (q->a): one line with one integer d, 1<=d<=11184; output the d-th emirp, a prime whose decimal reversal is a different prime (palindromic primes excluded), as one integer. Exactly 11184 emirps lie below 10^6, so the 10^6 sieve covers every d and every reversal. Output is unique; independently checked over the whole input domain by trial-division enumeration.
